anomalies.observed: On the Thermocouples sheet, the 1 µF capacitor C10 on channel U6 has its top plate tied to the horizontal SO/MISO wire that runs from U6 pin 7 to the global label NET0017, with its bottom plate on GND. Unlike U1 and U4, U6 has no local +3V3 power symbol feeding C10, and U6's VCC pin (pin 4) is left with only the +3V3 arrow and no decoupling capacitor.
anomalies.expected: The specification states each channel carries 'a 1 µF decoupling cap per channel' tied from VCC to GND (as drawn for U1/C7 and U4/C2, each of which has its own adjacent +3V3 symbol). The shared SPI MISO/SO net (NET0017) must not be loaded; U6's VCC must be decoupled.

evidence.quote: Thermocouples sheet (2/4): U6 MAX31855KASA, pin 7 SO -> NET0017, with C10 1uF hanging off that SO line to GND; U6 has a single +3V3 arrow at pin 4 and no +3V3 symbol above C10, whereas U1 and U4 each show a separate '+3V3' arrow directly above their 1uF cap (C7, C2).
Power: VCC (pin 4) -> +3V3, GND (pin 1) -> GND, with a 1 µF decoupling cap per channel (C3 for U2, C6 for U3, C4 for U4 ...).

anomalies.impact: A 1 µF capacitor from the shared 60 MHz SPI MISO line (NET0017) to ground presents a near-short at the SPI clock frequency, so the ESP32 cannot read valid data from any of the three MAX31855 devices (all zones would report garbage / thermocouple faults and the heater would trip on fault); U6's supply is also left undecoupled.
